Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with mild nausea

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 52-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoGluca (dose: 1 tablet twice daily) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-07-20.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Kim (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
